public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Kummer–Vandiver conjecture

*Reference:* [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kummer%E2%80%93Vandiver_conjecture)
-/

@[expose] public section

open NumberField CyclotomicField IsCyclotomicExtension

namespace KummerVandiver

-- TODO(Paul-Lez): change `PNat` to `Nat` once the version of Mathlib we're on allows it.

/--
Kummer–Vandiver conjecture states that for every prime $p$, the class number of the maximal
real subfield of $\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_p)$ is not divisible by $p$.
--/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem kummer_vandiver (p : ℕ+) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ¬ ↑p ∣ (classNumber (maximalRealSubfield (CyclotomicField p ℚ))) := by
  sorry

end KummerVandiver

reformulations.difference: Mathlib's maximalRealSubfield consists of elements real under every complex embedding of the abstract cyclotomic field, whereas the source describes the real subfield of Q(ζ_p) in its complex realization.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: These agree for cyclotomic fields. For p > 2 the field is CM, and its complex conjugation is compatible with every complex embedding; being real under one embedding is therefore equivalent to being real under all of them. For p = 2 the field is isomorphic to Q and is totally real. The scratch proof establishes, for every prime p, embedding φ, and element x, the equivalence x ∈ maximalRealSubfield (CyclotomicField p ℚ) ↔ ∃ r : ℝ, φ x = (r : ℂ). Thus the subfields correspond under the embedding and have the same class number.

review.notes: The sole theorem faithfully states the cited conjecture, and Wikipedia still explicitly records it as open. Checked that classNumber is the finite ideal-class-group cardinality of the ring of integers. /workspace/review/verification.lean compiles and independently proves the positive-prime/natural-prime quantifier equivalence, the real-subfield characterization, and the p = 2 boundary case (class number 1). These proofs do not depend on sorryAx. The reviewed file was not modified.
